{{Quote|The New Republic is a diverse group of worlds, with many species&mdash;not just humans, but Chadra Fan and Calamarians and Wookiees and all manner of intelligent races. I am insulted that Chief Organa Solo would pit us against each other so soon after we formed our government and drove out the hated Empire&mdash;the ''human'' Empire, I might add.|Trubor, to [[Kambrea]]|<ref name="TEP" />}}
'''Trubor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] who represented the planet [[Chad/Legends|Chadra]]. He was rather sympathetic with the [[Diversity Alliance]], and he didn't believe a word from [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Lowbacca]] about the true motives of the seemingly benevolent organization.

Trubor travelled to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] as part of a delegation to investigate these claims. Joining him were [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Cilghal]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. When the Diversity Alliance was exposed, he was killed in the [[Battle of Ryloth (Diversity Alliance Crisis)|crossfire]].
